# FLX-5003: value on the fixed-point grid is not exact

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

The grid accepts int, decimal.Decimal and fractions.Fraction only. A float, a non-finite Decimal, or any other class would make the encoded value depend on the platform's binary rounding, which is the one thing the grid exists to remove.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5003
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
